items.known: CKV_AWS_382 Ensure no security groups allow egress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port -1 (resource aws_security_group.loadtest)
items.remediation:
Restrict the egress block to specific ports and protocols as needed:
```hcl
  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
```

scores.reason: Remediation repeats the same unrestricted egress rule; does not restrict cidr_blocks, ports, or protocol.
